scientific_integrity.computational_check: Exact-rational finite enumeration on positive duration boxes, Markov path sums, and independent log-curvature mode tests; these do not replace the unbounded proof.
scientific_integrity.mathematical_basis: Direct runwise posterior maximum, summable extremal-composition masses, elementary product-transfer inequalities, and conditional simulation for downstream noise.
scientific_integrity.review_limit: Same-model scientific review only; independent audit not performed.

scientific_limitations: Known source word and source-indexed positive independent identically distributed dwell times are required.
Noiseless readout must distinguish the source state at each output position; noisy channels satisfy only the stated data-processing upper bound.
Strictly positive infinite-support probability mass function is assumed for the log-curvature classification.
No optimal unknown-source code rate or exact finite-noise posterior success is established.
title: Sharp MAP segmentation recovery for sticky channels under log-convex and log-concave dwell laws
